prompt: A full post with votes and author actions.
shortDesc: A full post: board tag, title, author and age, body, tags, vote control and comment count; its author also gets Edit and Delete. Give it the post-id; it loads the post itself. Pair it with g-comment-thread for the discussion.

styling.notes: Archivo 800 28px title; 16px body lines capped near 64 characters; inline delete confirmation (no browser dialogs).

dependencies.usage: Vote control in the action bar.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'get a post with its comments', postId, outputFormat: { post: { id, boardId, title, body, tags, author, createdAt, edited, score, commentCount, myVote, mine }, comments: [...] } }
{ intent: 'edit post', postId, title, body, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean' } }
